rt:param.name: Obj_Type_Nr
rt:param.comment: Номер схемы сигналов из конф. файла от 1 до 3

rt:var.name: STrig
rt:var.comment: наш вывод в ремонт - запрет управления

rt:var.name: More_signals
rt:var.comment: Есть ещё сигналы, найденные по маске

rt:var.name: Mask
rt:var.comment: Маска поиска дополнительных сигналов, сконструированная по гибкому правилу с учётом наличия точек

rt:var.name: DV_fill_dir
rt:var.comment: заливка барографа -1 = влево; 0 = от нуля 1 = вправо

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub HighlightMessage(ByVal TxtObj As RtSvgObj, ByVal pv As PlsPVBin, ByVal mask As UShort, ByVal HighlightColor As Int) If (pv == Nothing) || (mask == 0) Then TxtObj.visibility = "hidden" Else TxtObj.visibility = "visible" If pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" TxtObj.text_decoration = "password" ElseIf (pv.Value & mask) != 0 Then TxtObj.text_decoration = "none" TxtObj.fill = HighlightColor TxtObj.font_size = 13 TxtObj.font_weight = "bold" Else TxtObj.text_decoration = "none" TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" End If End If End Sub

Sub HighlightMessageSimple(ByVal TxtObj As RtSvgObj, ByVal Highlight As Boolean, ByVal HighlightColor As Int) If Highlight Then TxtObj.fill = HighlightColor TxtObj.font_size = 13 TxtObj.font_weight = "bold" Else TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" End If End Sub

Sub Auto_diag() HighlightMessage(A, pv_A, mask_A, 0) If Is_NARY Then HighlightMessage(H, pv_A, mask_H, 0) HighlightMessage(A_MISMATCH, pv_A, mask_A_MISMATCH, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(H_MISMATCH, pv_A, mask_H_MISMATCH, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(FAIL, pv_A, mask_FAIL, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(FAIL_BLINK, pv_A, mask_FAIL_BLINK, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(INVALID, pv_A, mask_INVALID, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(UNDEFINED, pv_A, mask_UNDEFINED, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(SELECTED, pv_A, mask_SELECTED, 0) End If End Sub

Sub DEVIATION_Status() Dim DV_txt As String Dim fx_val As Double Dim DV_val As Double If pv_DEVIATION == Nothing Then DV_txt = "---" gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.fill = Color_ErLink gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.visibility = "inherit" gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.fill = Color_ErLink Else DV_txt = pv_DEVIATION.ValueAscii() DV_val = pv_DEVIATION.Value If (pv_DEVIATION.QualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_RANGEEXCEEDED) Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.fill = Color_Inval gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.visibility = "inherit" gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.fill = Color_Inval Else Dim DVColor As UInt DVColor = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv(pv_DEVIATION) gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.fill = DVColor If DVColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.visibility = "hidden" Else gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.visibility = "inherit" End If gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.fill = DVColor End If
If DV_fill_dir > 0 Then //заливка слева направо fx_val = (DV_val - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) / (pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) If fx_val > 1.0 Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = 1 ElseIf fx_val < 0 Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = 0 Else gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = fx_val End If ElseIf DV_fill_dir < 0 Then //заливка справа налево fx_val = (DV_val - pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh) / (pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) If fx_val < -1.0 Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = 1 ElseIf fx_val > 0 Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = 0 Else gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.rt_fillx = fx_val End If Else //заливка от нуля Dim Pos_Zero As Float //абсолютная координата нуля Dim Pos_Val As Float //абсолютная координата столбика Pos_Zero = DV_X - DV_W * pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow / (pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) If DV_val > pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh Then DV_val = pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh ElseIf DV_val < pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow Then DV_val = pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow End If If DV_val > 0 Then //заливка положительной области gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.x = Pos_Zero gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.width = DV_W * DV_val / (pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) ElseIf DV_val < 0 Then //заливка отрицательной области Pos_Val = Pos_Zero + DV_W * DV_val / (pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh - pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow) gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.x = Pos_Val gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.width = Pos_Zero - Pos_Val Else //покажем ноль узенькой полоской gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.x = Pos_Zero - 1 gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar.width = 2 End If End IF End If gr_DEVIATION_DV_val.text = DV_txt Dim tmp_X As Float Dim tmp_Y As Float Dim tmp_W As Float Dim tmp_H As Float gr_DEVIATION_DV_val.CalculateTextSize(DV_txt , tmp_X, tmp_Y, tmp_W, tmp_H) gr_DEVIATION_DV_EU.x = tmp_X + tmp_W + 5 gr_DEVIATION_DV_bg.width = tmp_W + 5 End Sub

Sub SETPOINT_Status() Dim SP_txt As String If pv_SETPOINT == Nothing Then SP_txt = "---" gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.fill = Color_ErLink gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.visibility = "inherit" gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.fill = Color_ErLink gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.rt_fillx = 0 Else SP_txt = pv_SETPOINT.ValueAscii() If (pv_SETPOINT.QualitySubstatus == PLS_QUALSUB_RANGEEXCEEDED) Then gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.fill = Color_Inval gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.visibility = "inherit" gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.fill = Color_Inval Else Dim SPColor As UInt SPColor = PRJSPEC.ANA_Color_pv(pv_SETPOINT) gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.fill = SPColor If SPColor == Color_ANA_GOOD Then gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.visibility = "hidden" Else gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.visibility = "inherit" End If gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.fill = SPColor End If Dim fx_val As Double fx_val = (pv_SETPOINT.Value - pv_SETPOINT.RangeLow) / (pv_SETPOINT.RangeHigh - pv_SETPOINT.RangeLow) If fx_val > 1 Then gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.rt_fillx = 1 ElseIf fx_val < 0 Then gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.rt_fillx = 0 Else gr_SETPOINT_SP_bar.rt_fillx = fx_val End If End If gr_SETPOINT_SP_val.text = SP_txt Dim tmp_X As Float Dim tmp_Y As Float Dim tmp_W As Float Dim tmp_H As Float gr_SETPOINT_SP_val.CalculateTextSize(SP_txt , tmp_X, tmp_Y, tmp_W, tmp_H) gr_SETPOINT_SP_EU.x = tmp_X + tmp_W + 5 gr_SETPOINT_SP_bg.width = tmp_W + 5 End Sub

Dim TmpName As String If Obj_Type_Nr < 1 Then Obj_Type_Nr = 1 ElseIf Obj_Type_Nr > 3 Then Obj_Type_Nr = 3 End If SchemeNr = "SET" + CStr(Obj_Type_Nr) TopicID = "ObjectRules_" + SchemeNr Delimiter = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_DELIMITER")) Is_NARY = CBool(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_USE_SINGLE_NARY")) 'чтобы не задействовать лишние переменные If Is_NARY Then //это один NARY pv_A = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_AUTO"))) mask_A = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_AUTO")) mask_H = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_DIST")) mask_A_MISMATCH = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_AUTO_MISMATCH")) mask_H_MISMATCH = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_DIST_MISMATCH")) mask_FAIL = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_FAIL")) mask_FAIL_BLINK = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_FAIL_BLINK")) mask_INVALID = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_INVALID")) mask_UNDEFINED = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_UNDEFINED")) mask_SELECTED = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_SELECTED")) Else TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_AUTO")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_A = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_DIST")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_H = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_AUTO_MISMATCH")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_A_MISMATCH = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_DIST_MISMATCH")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_H_MISMATCH = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_FAIL")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_FAIL = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_FAIL_BLINK")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_FAIL_BLINK = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_INVALID")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_INVALID = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_UNDEFINED")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_UNDEFINED = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_SELECTED")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_SELECTED = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If If CBool(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_APPLY_MASK")) Then If pv_A != Nothing Then mask_A = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_AUTO")) End If If pv_H != Nothing Then mask_H = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_DIST")) End If If pv_A_MISMATCH != Nothing Then mask_A_MISMATCH = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_AUTO_MISMATCH")) End If If pv_H_MISMATCH != Nothing Then mask_H_MISMATCH = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_DIST_MISMATCH")) End If If pv_FAIL != Nothing Then mask_FAIL = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_FAIL")) End If If pv_FAIL_BLINK != Nothing Then mask_FAIL_BLINK = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_FAIL_BLINK")) End If If pv_INVALID != Nothing Then mask_INVALID = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_INVALID")) End If If pv_UNDEFINED != Nothing Then mask_UNDEFINED = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_UNDEFINED")) End If If pv_SELECTED != Nothing Then mask_SELECTED = CUInt(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_MASK_SELECTED")) End If End If End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_DEVIATION")) DV_X = gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar_RB.x DV_W = gr_DEVIATION_DV_bar_RB.width If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_DEVIATION = ANA(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) If pv_DEVIATION != Nothing Then gr_DEVIATION_DV_EU.text = pv_DEVIATION.DimString If pv_DEVIATION.RangeLow >= 0 Then DV_fill_dir = 1 ElseIf pv_DEVIATION.RangeHigh <= 0 Then DV_fill_dir = -1 End If End If End If TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_SETPOINT")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_SETPOINT = ANA(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) If pv_SETPOINT != Nothing Then gr_SETPOINT_SP_EU.text = pv_SETPOINT.DimString End If End If
//изначально всё пусть будет скрыто A.visibility = "hidden" H.visibility = "hidden" A_MISMATCH.visibility = "hidden" H_MISMATCH.visibility = "hidden" FAIL.visibility = "hidden" FAIL_BLINK.visibility = "hidden" INVALID.visibility = "hidden" UNDEFINED.visibility = "hidden" SELECTED.visibility = "hidden"
TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_COMMAND")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_OU = BIN(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If If (pv_OU == nothing) Then No_OU = True ElseIf (pv_OU.PVCategories != 2) Then No_OU = True Else No_OU = False End If If No_OU Then NO_OU.title = "Переменная " + KKS + Delimiter + TmpName + " не найдена или ее тип не Out" End If
TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_SIGNAL_SP_COMMAND")) If TmpName != "NONE" Then pv_SP = ANA(KKS + Delimiter + TmpName) End If If (pv_SP == nothing) Then No_SP = True ElseIf (pv_SP.PVCategories != 2) Then No_SP = True Else No_SP = False End If If No_SP Then NO_SP.title = "Переменная " + KKS + Delimiter + TmpName + " не найдена или ее тип не Out" End If
TmpName = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(True, TopicID, SchemeNr + "_AUX_SIGNAL_MASK")) If Left(TmpName, 1) == "." Then 'если первый символ = точка, значит задана маска с точками Mask = PRJSPEC.BuildFinalMask(KKS, TmpName) Else 'иначе - маской является расширение после разделителя Mask = KKS + Delimiter + TmpName End If Dim selBINs(100) As Int Dim selANAs(100) As Int Dim actualANAs As Int Dim actualBINs As Int More_signals = PRJSPEC.GET_Selection(Mask, actualANAs, actualBINs, selANAs, selBINs)

If pv_DEVIATION != nothing Then Call_Win ("ws_ANA_FN", pv_DEVIATION.PVId) End If
